title: Tooltip placement
responsibility: Chooses a tooltip position and optional height based on its anchor and available viewport room.

inputs.name: tooltipPlace.mark
inputs.description: The rectangle the tooltip belongs to, with numeric left, top, width, and height. Its horizontal center and top and bottom edges set the candidate alignment and vertical positions; the function uses coordinates as given.

inputs.name: tooltipPlace.tip
inputs.description: The numeric width and height of the tooltip. Its width controls horizontal centering, and its height is checked against the available room above and below the mark; values are used as given.

inputs.name: tooltipPlace.view
inputs.description: The numeric width and height of the view containing the tooltip. Its width sets the horizontal clamp and its height determines the room below the mark; values are used as given.

outputs.name: tooltipPlace
outputs.type: { left: number; top: number; height?: number }
outputs.description: The horizontal left and vertical top positions, with an optional height when the tooltip cannot fit above or below; the horizontal clamp may not keep an overwide tooltip within the view. It centers horizontally and applies an 8-pixel gap; it prefers below when that fits, otherwise above when that fits, and if neither fits uses the roomier side (below on a tie) with that room as height, starting at the 8-pixel gap when above is chosen.
